sourceWitness.excerpt: 薦棘而陵舊主；萇乃掘苻堅屍，鞭撻無數，裸剝衣裳，薦之以棘，坎土而埋之。

sourceUnits.en: Yao Zan reached Qinzhou, then withdrew to Chouqi.
sourceUnits.literal: Zan reached Qinzhou and withdrew to Chouqi.

sourceUnits.zh: 泓使輔國斂曼嵬、前將軍姚光兒討楊倦于陳倉，倦奔于散關。
sourceUnits.en: Yao Hong sent Lian Mankui and Yao Guang'er to Chencang; Yang Juan bolted for Sanguan.
sourceUnits.literal: Hong sent General Who Supports the State Lian Mankui and Forward General Yao Guang'er to campaign against Yang Juan at Chencang; Juan fled to Sanguan.

sourceUnits.zh: 懿左常侍張敞、侍郎左雅固諫懿曰：「殿下以母弟之親，居分陝之重，安危休戚，與國共之。
sourceUnits.en: Zhang Chang and Zuo Ya warned: "You are the emperor's uncle on the western front—your fate is the dynasty's fate.
sourceUnits.literal: Yi's left constant attendant Zhang Chang and attendant Zuo Ya firmly remonstrated Yi, saying, "Your Highness, with the closeness of mother's-brother kin, holds the weight of dividing Shaan; safety and peril, rest and sorrow, you share with the state.

sourceUnits.zh: 於是遣姚贊及冠軍司馬國璠、建義蛇玄屯陝津，武衛姚驢屯潼關。
sourceUnits.en: He sent Yao Zan, Simo Guofan, and She Xuan to Shan and Yao Lü to Tong Pass.
sourceUnits.literal: Thereupon he sent Yao Zan and champion major Simo Guofan, Jianyi She Xuan to camp at Shan ford, Martial Guard Yao Lü to camp at Tong Pass.

sourceUnits.zh: 懿又遣驍騎王國率甲士數百攻成都，成都擒國，囚之，遣讓懿曰：「明公以母弟之親，受推轂之寄，今社稷之危若綴旒然，宜恭恪憂勤，匡輔王室。
sourceUnits.en: Chengdu captured Wang Guo and scolded Yao Yi: "As the emperor's uncle you should steady the throne, not plot treason.
sourceUnits.literal: Yi also sent swift cavalry Wang Guo leading several hundred armored soldiers to attack Chengdu; Chengdu seized Guo, imprisoned him, sent reproach to Yi, saying, "The enlightened lord, with mother's-brother closeness, received the charge of the pushing-bar wheel; now the altars' peril hangs like a tassel—he ought reverently to toil in worry and assist the royal house.

sourceUnits.zh: 恢舅苟和時為立節將軍，守忠不貳，泓召而謂之曰：「眾人咸懷去就，卿何能自安邪？」
sourceUnits.en: Yao Hong summoned Gou He and asked, "Everyone is weighing whether to leave or stay—how can you alone remain at ease?"
sourceUnits.literal: Hui's maternal uncle Gou He then served as Jianjie general, kept loyalty without wavering; Hong summoned him and said, "The multitude all harbor leaving or staying—how can you alone be at ease?"

sourceUnits.zh: 和曰：「若天縱妖賊，得肆其逆節者，舅甥之理，不待賓士而加親。
sourceUnits.en: Gou He said: "If treason wins, uncle and nephew share the stain.
sourceUnits.literal: He said, "If Heaven lets the demon bandit prevail and he gets to carry out his treason, the principle of uncle and nephew needs no guest-retainer to grow closer.

sourceUnits.zh: 時泓遣姚諶守堯柳，姚和都討薛帛於河東，聞王師要難，乃兼道赴救，未至而難敗，固破裕裨將于河曲，遂屯蒲阪。
sourceUnits.en: Yao Chen raced to save Yao Nan, missed him, but beat a Jin column in the bend and held Puban.
sourceUnits.literal: At the time Hong had sent Yao Chen to guard Yaoliu, Yao Hedou campaigned against Xue Bo in Hedong; hearing the royal army was intercepting Nan, they hurried by combined roads to rescue; before arriving Nan was defeated, yet they broke Liu Yu's lieutenant at the river bend, then camped at Puban.

sourceUnits.zh: 鎮東姚璞及姚和都擊敗猗之等於蒲阪，猗之遇害，超石棄其眾奔於潼關。
sourceUnits.en: Yao Pu crushed Jin at Puban; Xu Yi died and Zhu Chaoshi ran.
sourceUnits.literal: General Who Conquers the East Yao Pu and Yao Hedou defeated Yi and others at Puban; Yi met death; Chaoshi abandoned his host and fled to Tong Pass.

sourceUnits.en: Yao Hong brought his family to Liu Yu's camp and yielded.
sourceUnits.literal: Hong led wife and children to the camp gate and surrendered.

sourceUnits.zh: 姚萇以孝武太元九年僭立，至泓三世，以安帝義熙十三年而滅，凡三十二年。
sourceUnits.en: From Yao Chang's usurpation in the ninth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu to the fall in the thirteenth year of Yixi under Emperor An, the Later Qin lasted three reigns and thirty-two years.
sourceUnits.literal: Yao Chang presumptuously rose in the ninth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu; down to Hong three generations; in the thirteenth year of Yixi under Emperor An they perished—thirty-two years in all.

sourceUnits.zh: 景茂因仲襄之緒，躡苻亡之會，嘯命群豪，恢弘霸業，假容沖之銳，俯定函、秦；
sourceUnits.en: Yao Chang took up Yao Xiang's legacy, stepped into Fu Jian's fall, whistled command to the heroes, enlarged the hegemon's enterprise, and borrowed Murong Chong's edge to settle Hangu and Qin.
sourceUnits.literal: Jingmao took up Zhongxiang's thread, stepped into Fu's fall, whistled command to the heroes, enlarged the hegemon's enterprise—borrowed Chong's edge to bow and settle Han and Qin;

sourceUnits.en: He broke Murong Chui's power and quieted the northeast.
sourceUnits.literal: broke the point of Lei E, brought peace to the northeast.

sourceUnits.zh: 薦棘而陵舊主，何其不仁！
sourceUnits.en: Yet he trampled his old lord Fu Jian—heartless.
sourceUnits.literal: pushing brambles to climb the old lord—how lacking in benevolence!

sourceUnits.zh: 子略克摧勍敵，荷成先構，虛襟訪道，側席求賢，敦友弟以睦其親，明賞罰以臨其下，英髦盡節，爪牙畢命。
sourceUnits.en: Yao Xing broke strong enemies, finished his father's work, sought wise counsel, knit his clan, and ruled with clear rewards—rivaling Zhuang of Chu or Mu of Qin.
sourceUnits.literal: Zilue was able to crush mighty foes, bore the completed prior structure, emptied breast to visit the Way, set aside mat to seek worthies, thickly befriended younger brothers to harmonize kin, clarified rewards and punishments to face those below—heroes exhausted their integrity, claws and fangs gave their lives.

sourceUnits.zh: 取汾、絳，陷許、洛，款僭燕而籓偽蜀，夷隴右而靜河西，俗阜年豐，遠安邇輯，雖楚莊、秦穆何以加焉！
sourceUnits.en: At his height he held the heartland and the west in prosperity few could match.
sourceUnits.literal: He took Fen and Jiang, fell Xu and Luo, treated false Yan as vassal and hedged false Shu, leveled Longyou and quieted Hexi—customs rich, years abundant, far quieted and near gathered—though Chu Zhuang or Qin Mu, how could they surpass!

sourceUnits.zh: 凶嗣失圖，系組而降軹道。
sourceUnits.en: the last heir bound himself at Zhidao.
sourceUnits.literal: the wicked heir lost his plan, tied cord and surrendered at Zhidao.

units.zh: 姚興，字子略，萇之長子也。
units.en: Yao Xing, courtesy Zilüe, was the firstborn of Yao Chang.
units.literal: Yao Xing, style name Zilüe, was Yao Chang's eldest son.

units.zh: 以升平元年僭稱大秦天王，誅生幸臣董龍、趙韶等二十餘人，赦其境內，改元曰永興。
units.en: In the first year of Shengping he assumed the title Great Heavenly King of Qin, put to death over twenty of Fu Sheng’s favorites including Dong Long and Zhao Shao, proclaimed a general amnesty, and adopted the era name Yongxing.
units.literal: In the first year of the Shengping reign period he presumptuously styled himself Great Heavenly King of Great Qin, executed more than twenty of Sheng’s favored ministers such as Dong Long and Zhao Shao, issued an amnesty within his borders, and changed the era name to Yongxing.

units.zh: 堅既不許萇以禪代，罵而求死，萇乃縊堅于新平佛寺中，時年四十八。
units.en: and when Fu Jian kept defying and demanding death, Yao Chang strangled him in a Xinping monastery at age forty-eight.
units.literal: Since Jian would not grant Chang abdication-in-succession but cursed and sought death, Chang thereupon strangled Jian in a Xinping Buddhist monastery—his years forty-eight.

units.zh: 中山公詵及張夫人並自殺。
units.en: Fu Shen and Lady Zhang killed themselves with him.
units.literal: Duke of Zhongshan Shen and Lady Zhang both killed themselves.

units.en: It was the tenth year of the Jin Taiyuan era.
units.literal: That year was the tenth year of Taiyuan.

units.zh: 萇乃掘苻堅屍，鞭撻無數，裸剝衣裳，薦之以棘，坎土而埋之。
units.en: Then he dug up Fu Jian, lashed the corpse, stripped it, heaped thorns atop it, and shoveled dirt.
units.literal: Chang thereupon exhumed Fu Jian's corpse, flogged it countless times, stripped the garments bare, laid it on brambles, and buried it in a pit of earth.

units.zh: 雷惡地率眾降萇，拜為鎮東將軍。
units.en: Lei Edi brought his column in and earned general who guards the east.
units.literal: Lei Edi led his host to surrender to Chang and was appointed General Who Guards the East.

units.zh: 魏褐飛自稱大將軍、沖天王，率氐胡數萬人攻安北姚當城於杏城，雷惡地應之，攻鎮東姚漢得于李潤。
units.en: Wei Hefei proclaimed himself grand general and Heaven-Rushing King, threw Di and Hu tens of thousands deep against Yao Dangcheng at Xingcheng; Lei Edi pitched in against Yao Hande at Lirun.
units.literal: Wei Hefei styled himself Grand General and Heaven-Rushing King and led tens of thousands of Di and Hu to assault General Who Guards the North Yao Dangcheng at Xingcheng; Lei Edi answered him and attacked General Who Guards the East Yao Hande at Lirun.

units.zh: 萇議將討之，群臣咸曰：「陛下不憂六十里苻登，乃憂六百里褐飛？」
units.en: Ministers protested, "Fu Deng sits sixty li off while Hefei marches six hundred—why fear the distant bandit?"
units.literal: Chang debated campaigning against them; all ministers said: "Your Majesty does not worry over Fu Deng sixty li away, yet worries over Wei Hefei six hundred li away?"

units.zh: 萇曰：「登非可卒殄，吾城亦非登所能卒圖。
units.en: Chang answered, "Deng will not fall overnight; neither will he swallow my towns at a stroke.
units.literal: Chang said: "Deng cannot be crushed in haste; neither can my cities be swiftly mapped by Deng.

units.zh: 萇命其將當城于營處一柵孔中蒔樹一根，以旌戰功。
units.en: He told Yao Dangcheng to raise one victory tree in a palisade gap.
units.literal: Chang ordered general Dangcheng to plant one tree in a single fence hole at the camp site to signal martial merit.

structuralFindings: Keep p036 Yao Zan’s arrival (m0207/m0208, c1150). The withdrawal is by p031 Yang Sheng; retract c1151 and add c2091. Check the English link to p031; no Chinese 盛 span appears in this chapter's text. Collation says 退還上脫盛字.
p055 斂曼嵬 is Lian Manwei. Retain Chinese m0282, check the English m0278 and c0218/c0220. Tongjian 117 s0242m also names him.

母弟 identifies p086 Yi as Hong’s full younger brother. Preserve c1483/c1484/c1485, review c1483’s paternal-only line. P119’s c1448 and c1479 wrongly assign the AD 417 activity and Later Qin service to their mother. She is distinct from p118.
冠軍將軍司馬國璠 is Champion General Sima Guofan. Check p094 m0460/m0464 and c0415/c0416/c1501. Weishu 42 s0016 and Tongjian 117 s0396f attest name and rank; Weishu 37 s0252 attests his name.
Chen p145 guards Yaoliu, Hedu p143 undertakes the relief march, Nan p144 is beset. Retract c1791, revise c1792, add c2092; check Chen’s distinct spans, Hedu’s full name and his three callbacks.
p163 Pu and p164 Hedu co-command, p157 Yizhi is defeated and then killed, p156 Chaoshi flees. Verify both Yizhi occurrences and Hedu; keep p143/p164 and p136/p162 separate pending identity review.

Wang Zhen'e owns the camp gate, per Tongjian 118 s0191b. Revise c1979 to p161. Remove English m0952 Liu Yu. Narrow m0954/c0717 wife p182’s individual span from 妻子 (wife and children) to 妻, preserving combined phrase in evidence.

仲 identifies p186 Yizhong and 襄 p188 Xiang. Split m0981, retain c2093/c2094 and remove fictitious Zhongxiang c0736. 苻 refers to the Fu house. Remove personal spans m0978/m0982 for p190 and retain c0743/c1858/c1904 retractions. P190 remains evidenced by 舊主 in s0258.

p192 is Lei Edi, not Murong Chui. Jinshu 116 s0208–s0226 and Tongjian 107 s0350–a, s0368–m corroborate. Check m0984/m0985 and c0749/c0750/c1860/c2043, and independently audit the Taiyuan 15 / AD 390 chronology.

子略 is Xing’s courtesy name; 子 is no independent son reference. The comparison with King Zhuang and Duke Mu continues at s0261 楚莊/秦穆. Check m0989/990 at s0261 alongside m0992/993 and c0755/58. Retain c0756/59 retractions. Hold c1956’s use of 子 in 子略, distinguish separate support for Xing’s paternal genealogy in Jinshu 117 s0003.

Shiji 6 s0664 identifies Qin Ziying's neck cord at Zhidao. Hong's surrender at Wang Zhen'e’s camp gate is in s0245 and Tongjian 118 s0191b. Keep c2054 retraction and c2053 assessment distinct from literal event. Existing literal repair already included.
